offline-edit.title: Open an example and make a first edit
offline-edit.description: Open QWERTY Example, open Standard Keys and drag A onto Q.

macro-full.title: Create and assign a text macro
macro-full.description: Add a Text action containing hello, close the editor, and drag Macro 0 onto Q. Both the definition and the invoking key are now in the offline draft.

tap-dance-action.title: Configure and assign a tap dance
tap-dance-action.description: Enable entry 0, assign A to Tap and B to Double-Tap, then drag its tile onto Q. The recording shows configuration; test physical tap timing on your board.

combo-action.title: Make A + B send Escape
combo-action.description: Enable a combo, choose A and B as its first two inputs, then set Output to Escape. No separate combo key is needed.

override-action.title: Make Shift + Backspace send Delete
override-action.description: Enable the entry, choose Backspace and Delete, and select Shift in both Trigger and Suppressed. Suppressing Shift means the replacement is Delete without Shift.

leader-action.title: Set up Leader, A, B
leader-action.description: Enable the A-then-B sequence with Macro 0 as its output, then assign the Leader key. Create the hello macro in the preceding example first.

alt-repeat-action.title: Map A to B and assign alternate repeat
alt-repeat-action.description: Enable the A-to-B mapping, then place the Alt-Rep key in the layout. This records configuration, not firmware execution.

preferences-action.title: Change appearance and turn off typing assignment
preferences-action.description: Try Dark, return to Light, and switch Typing Binds a Key off. These preferences belong to this browser.

compare-layers.title: Compare layers together
compare-layers.description: Use Show Multiple Layers, then 3D View to change the presentation. Viewing a layer does not activate it on the keyboard.

rename-layer.title: Give a layer a useful name
rename-layer.description: Click Layer 0, enter Base, and leave the field to save the name in this offline layout.

reopen-layout.title: Return to a saved file
reopen-layout.description: Choose Load File on the welcome screen and open a .svil file. The operating-system file chooser is not included in this browser recording.

import-action.title: Review and open an imported layout
import-action.description: Use Import Layout, read the offline review, then choose Open layout. On a connected board the review and write controls differ; see the steps below.

pointing-action.title: Adjust one pointer setting
pointing-action.description: Change the left pointer from 800 to 1200 DPI. This uses controlled test-board data to demonstrate the controls; it is not a recommended sensitivity or a sensor test.

timing-action.title: Stage a timing change and inspect it
timing-action.description: Change Tapping Term from 200 to 210 ms and open Pending (1). Controlled test-board data; the recording does not write physical hardware.

modtap-action.title: Make one key A on tap and Control on hold
modtap-action.description: Assign A, select the position again, choose CTRL, then choose the generated mod-tap tile. Assignment can clear selection, so reselect before composing.

oneshot-action.title: Assign one-shot Shift
oneshot-action.description: Select a position, choose SHIFT, and select the OSM tile. On your board, tap and release this key before typing the letter you want shifted.

blank-transparent.title: Choose Transparent or Blank in Keybard
blank-transparent.description: On layer 3, set the A position to Transparent, then Blank. Return to base: A is still there. The comparison below explains what happens when the upper layer is active.

navigation-layer.title: Build a small navigation layer
navigation-layer.description: On unused layer 3, select three positions and press Left, Down, and Right to assign them using Typing Binds a Key. Return to base and assign MO(3). The remaining layer-3 positions inherit through Transparent.

layer-tap-action.title: Combine a tap key with a layer hold
layer-tap-action.description: Assign A, select it again, choose Layer Keys → LT, then choose layer 3. The resulting key is A on tap and layer 3 on hold.

swap-keys.title: Swap two existing keys
swap-keys.description: Drag Q onto A to exchange their bindings, then drag them back to restore the original layout. Palette-to-layout dragging assigns; layout-to-layout dragging swaps.

save-library.title: Save a reusable layer
save-library.description: Open the layer actions, choose Save Layer…, give it a name, and find it in Layouts. This is local browser storage, not a complete backup file.

reuse-layer.title: Apply a layer from the library
reuse-layer.description: Choose destination layer 3, drag the library’s Layer 0 preview onto it, read the replacement confirmation, and choose OK. Check the destination before confirming.

print-action.title: Prepare a printed layer reference
print-action.description: Open Print Layers, review the layer count, click Print, and show the verified printable keyboard layout.

matrix-action.title: Read and clear Matrix Tester history
matrix-action.description: Open Matrix Tester, see three switch reports, then use Clear Matrix. Reports are simulated test-board data; this is not a physical switch test.

fragments-action.title: Inspect the board’s fragment arrangement
fragments-action.description: Open Settings → Fragments to review the available cluster controls. Only change these to match the hardware you actually have.

trainer-appearance.title: Choose a readable overlay style
trainer-appearance.description: Apply High contrast, then try the Busy background to judge readability. This is the browser appearance preview.

trainer-feedback.title: Preview highlighting
trainer-feedback.description: Choose Short fade and use Preview held keys to see a simulated chord. The browser preview does not measure native overlay latency.

trainer-practice-action.title: Practice one recall prompt
trainer-practice-action.description: Enable Recall practice, decide where the requested binding lives, Reveal it, then choose Remembered to advance. Grading is your own assessment.

trainer-familiar.title: Hide a binding you already know
trainer-familiar.description: Select a familiar binding, choose Mark familiar, and enable Hide familiar legends. The preview hides that binding’s legend.

trainer-layers.title: Look at different layers in Trainer
trainer-layers.description: Change Preview layer from base to symbols to function keys, then return to base. This only changes the preview.

manual-apply.title: Review and apply a queued change
manual-apply.description: Change one setting in Manual Updates, inspect Pending (1), then choose Apply 1 Change. The write endpoint is simulated test-board data; no physical keyboard is changed.

overlay-layers.title: See the overlay respond to layer changes
overlay-layers.description: The actual shared native renderer receives controlled reports: base, symbols, function keys, then base with held-key highlighting. This demonstrates rendering; it is not a Windows desktop recording or a hardware latency test.

opening-drag.title: Open the panel and drag a letter
opening-drag.description: Open Standard Keys, drag A onto Q without selecting the destination first, and verify A.
